title: Combined every tool that can build a game with claude for 2 days of work
author: Active_Woodpecker683
selftext:
I used 

\- autodesk maya (Trial) for animations

\- houdini (apprentice)

\- tripo3d and trellis (local model generates 3d objects from images created by codex)

\-blender (enhance trellis / tripo3d and add animations)

  
All connected with claude MCP, used codex as the artist generating scene images for claude to build

  
what to do you think? still polishing and adding the building interiors but am super amazed with how much AI can do rn

comments.author: Kindly-Sail6260
comments.body: Not bad but it’s really laggy. Might have to check level streaming, see if assets are instanced, whether materials and textures are using their instanced textures/materials versions instead of their master versions, etc. I think an optimization pass would really help get it all together. I’d also suggest looking at Unreals Game Animation Sample. They have over like 200-500 different animations to blend everything together. You could potentially use that movement system and combine those with your soldiers animations to really juice up the movement. Not bad for a proof of concept though!
